import Mathlib

theorem p09 (n : ℕ) : 7 ∣ 8 ^ n - 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      have hpow : 1 ≤ 8 ^ n := by positivity
      have hmul : 7 ∣ 8 * (8 ^ n - 1) := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right ih 8
      have hadd : 7 ∣ 8 * (8 ^ n - 1) + 7 := dvd_add hmul (dvd_refl 7)
      convert hadd using 1 <;> omega
